title: K computer, SPARC64 VIIIfx 2.0GHz, Tofu interconnect

passages.locator: Performance and list history, 06/2011 and 11/2011 rows
passages.note: TOP500 lists SPARC64 VIIIfx and Tofu. The June configuration had 548,352 cores and 8,162.00 TFlop/s Rmax. The November configuration had 705,024 cores and 10,510.00 TFlop/s Rmax. Rmax is distinct from Rpeak.
